# GFunnel Methodology (Omni Process)

> A unified framework claiming one invariant algorithm — DETECT → PROCESS → RESPOND — operating at every scale of reality. Expressed in 17 layers, 10 Universal Process Domains, and 70+ operational algorithms (v5.1), run against itself at higher resolution (v5.2), and extended with a meta-tier, the Container ⊙ (v5.3), then run through it (v5.4). Authored by Cameron Garlick, GFunnel, Austin, Texas.

Read AGENTS.md first for the operating protocol. The base code does not change between versions; each version loads the prior as substrate. Never fill a held-open variable with assumption.

## Canonical versions

- [v5.1 — The Complete System](versions/v5.1/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.1.md): Full architecture; self-contained; start here.
- [v5.2 — The Framework Run Against Itself](versions/v5.2/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.2.md): Deep-lens runs; narrows held-open variables; no new architecture.
- [v5.3 — The Meta-Tier](versions/v5.3/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.3.md): First architectural addition; Layer ⊙, the Container.
- [v5.4 — Run 8](versions/v5.4/GFunnel-Methodology-v5.4.md): The first run executed with the meta-tier. Line-Field, Knot-Line, Lamina; motion as tying/untying; frequency as the line-field on the time axis (§4a); three test devices. Derivations only; zero novel predictions claimed.
- [LATEST pointer](versions/LATEST.md): What the current complete framework is.

## Map (navigable index)

- [Framework map](framework/README.md): The whole framework at a glance.
- [Layers](framework/layers.md): The 16 layers, each with a deep link into v5.1.
- [Domains](framework/domains.md): The ten Universal Process Domains.
- [Algorithms](framework/algorithms.md): Algorithm Index by problem type.
- [Registers](framework/registers.md): Variable Registry, Falsifiability, Iteration Ledger.
- [Gaps](framework/gaps.md): The gap numbering v5.4 reports against, reconstructed from canon.
- [Tests](framework/tests/README.md): Executed runs from v5.4 §14, with scripts and honest verdicts.

## Reality Audit (derivation / work-in-progress — not canon)

- [Audit overview](audit/README.md): Compares canon against measured reality, item by item. Nothing here is canon until the author declares a version.
- [Audit schema](audit/SCHEMA.md): Vocabularies (observation grade, claim outcome, diff state, exclusion diagnosis, intake result) and record formats.
- [Findings](audit/FINDINGS.md): Running list of confirmed findings and questions for the author.
- [Coverage](audit/COVERAGE.md): What is audited, sparse, or blind.
- [Containers](containers/README.md): Knowledge containers (KC-####), one per solved item, each with at least one open edge.
- [Substrate](substrate/README.md): Dated input documents, including the audit's governing model (unclassified).
- [Task brief](tasks/reality-audit/TASK.md): The standing brief for every audit phase.
